title: The Day of the Fresh Pencil Case
skyStory: A brand new moon is hiding in Virgo, which means it has alphabetized the stars and labelled the shelf they go on. September has arrived carrying a lunchbox and a clipboard. Saturn approves of the clipboard. Mars wants to know who decided summer was over, and has filed a formal complaint with the tide. The tide is not taking questions.

reading: There is a back-to-school feeling in the air even though nobody is handing you a timetable. The Fire Tiger sniffs a crisp breeze at 7:40 am and decides this is the season of Big Plans. Write them down. Then cross off all but one, because the [[Knight of Wands]] has seen your list from August and is still recovering.

Somebody will ask how your summer went. Resist the urge to deliver a twelve-minute keynote with slides. Give them one good story, the best one, the one with the unexpected goat or the wrong turn. Life Path 3 means you can make a single sentence glitter. Today, prove it in under thirty seconds and watch them laugh anyway.
joel.mission: Sharpen one actual pencil, by hand if you can, and write tomorrow's single most important task with it.
joel.omen: A leaf already turned orange while its neighbours stay green. Someone near you is ready to start early; cheer them on.

reading: Virgo is your kind of moon: tidy, observant, mildly smug about it. The Wood Rat wakes up already knowing which drawer is out of order and which person in the meeting has not read the document. You will say nothing. You will simply smile, and that smile will be filed by the universe under Evidence.

Midafternoon brings a small mess that is somebody else's job. Let it stay somebody else's job. The [[Six of Swords]] reminds you that crossing the water does not mean carrying everyone else's luggage in the boat. Row your own oars today, steady as a lighthouse, and enjoy how light the boat feels.
nancy.mission: Organize exactly one small thing, a junk drawer or a desktop folder, and then stop, triumphant, before it becomes three things.
nancy.omen: A neatly folded note or receipt on the ground. Your instincts about a plan are right; trust the first read.

together.text: Trade one goal each for September, written as if it were a school project title, the more pompous the better. Example format: A Formal Inquiry Into Finally Fixing The Porch Light. Grade each other generously. The moon is new and gives extra credit to anyone who starts.

game.intro: New moon, new pencil case. Saturn sharpened every crayon in the studio and now dares you to zoom way, way in.
game.prompt: Something on your desk or table that has been sitting there since before summer started.
